name: game-tracker-bot
install:
export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24; nvm alias default 24; nvm use 24; fi
cursor_node_bin="${NVM_BIN:?Node 24 was not initialized}"
export PATH="$cursor_node_bin:$PATH"
hash -r
node --version
for cursor_profile in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.bash_profile"; do
  cursor_profile_tmp=$(mktemp "${cursor_profile}.XXXXXX")
  printf 'export PATH="%s:%s:$PATH" # cursor-cloud-node24\n' "$cursor_node_bin" "$HOME/.railway/bin" > "$cursor_profile_tmp"
  if [ -f "$cursor_profile" ]; then sed '/# cursor-cloud-node24$/d' "$cursor_profile" >> "$cursor_profile_tmp"; fi
  mv "$cursor_profile_tmp" "$cursor_profile"
done
# pnpm verify reads production over railway ssh
curl -fsSL https://railway.com/install.sh | sh -s -- --yes
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.16.0 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
